root_text: @Marion16moore @BGatesIsaPyscho yup, it’s just hMPV, ~800 million cases globally every year, China’s share is ~140 million cases annually. It’s winter … normal colds, flus & hMPV. Flu shots are not popular in China, ~17% get them.
